summary: Lufax filed a 6-K carrying a Hong Kong profit warning and CFO appointment announcements. The profit warning flags an expected net loss of RMB1.30–1.70 billion for Q3 2026, versus roughly RMB694 million lost in H1 2026, attributed to higher credit impairment losses, reduced deferred tax assets at a financing guarantee subsidiary, and added tax from planned domestic-to-overseas dividend distributions after redeeming the An Ke Technology convertible notes at maturity. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction terms appear. Routine earnings caution and an executive appointment, not a special situation.
